name: com.testerexchange/tester-exchange
title: Tester Exchange
description: Gets Android developers the 12 testers × 14 days Google Play requires for closed testing. Real people test on their own phones; pay once or test other apps for free. Start with get_testers.

authentication.description: API key from https://testerexchange.com/api. Without it only about, platform_stats and pricing work; get_testers needs a key. No OAuth.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. 'Bearer tx_...' API key from https://testerexchange.com/api. Without it only about, platform_stats and pricing work; get_testers needs a key.
